blocks.x: Failure modes & the guards we ship
Known failure modes, engineered out at the architecture level:

items: Duplicated work
Duplicated work — blackboard contracts make task claims exclusive, so two agents can never own the same case, enforced by the platform rather than by discipline alone
Runaway loops
Runaway loops: durable execution caps retries, tool calls and spend per run; breach trips a kill switch that pages the owner; the guard is part of the first slice, not a hardening phase
Agent sprawl
Agent sprawl: every agent ships with a role spec, budget and owner — unregistered agents are quarantined at the queue; the guard is part of the first slice, not a hardening phase
